craft_notes: Sthāyin: reasoning beyond supports. Device: dashes→commas (mark stated plainly, Name lands on colon). Rejected: capitalising NAME — killed: shouting cheapens; the question does the lifting. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Past strand and phase, his mark is the Temple's crown, Dhūrjaṭi's,
his very Name: what prop besides bears fruit for brooders?
l4.sanskrit_cite: vyatītaguṇayogasya mukhyadhyeyasya dhūrjaṭeḥ nāmāpi dhyāyatāṃ dhyānaiḥ kim anyālambanaiḥ phalam

reads_against.argmap: Of past-guṇa-yoga's chief meditation-object, of Dhūrjaṭi: even the name.; Of meditators, by meditations — what fruit by other supports? → Dhūrjaṭi's name alone outdoes all meditations; other supports are fruitless.
c1_essence: Independent trident power in all cosmic tasks; Dhūrjaṭi's name outdoes meditations.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-śānta with abhilāṣa (longing to see and stay)
reads_against.l2: Of the chief meditation-object past guṇa-yoga, of Dhūrjaṭi — even the name: for meditators, by meditations, what fruit by other supports?

reads_against.t1: What fruit from other supports for those who meditate — even the name of Dhūrjaṭi, chief meditation-object past guṇa-yoga?
